thread:
Elaine: Hey team — final draft for the product launch blog + webinar CTA is in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xExampleLink. Target publish window: 3/26 noon PT. Please review: headline, benchmark phrasing, hero image, webinar registration flow, UTMs, and inbound routing to Sales. @Jess for hero, @Mike for lead routing, @Nora for legal, @Oliver for benchmark numbers, @Sam for CRO/UTM. I need final call by EOD today.

Jess: Okaaaay will mock 2 hero options (graph vs screenshot) and push to Figma by 5pm. :art:

Oliver: Which model and workload are we quoting for the latency/cost numbers? I'll pull the perf sheet.

Elaine: Proposed wording in the doc right now: “p95 latency under 120ms and up to 30% lower inference cost vs baseline.” Model: redwood-4x, 2k context, text-complete workload. But please confirm exact numbers or suggest rewording.

Oliver: Don't use vague "baseline" — legal/accuracy will flag. Also don't say "under 120ms" unless we can cite p95=118ms consistently. I'll confirm exact p95 and cost delta from the benchmark sheet. Expect numbers by 3pm.

Nora: Quick legal flags: no customer logos or names without signed LOA. Avoid absolutes like "fastest". Prefer phrasing like "based on internal testing" and add a short methodology link. Also steer away from naming competitor models in headlines.

Mike: For lead routing: route webinar signups to HubSpot list "inbound-webinar-apr" and tag leads as source=blog; set initial routing to SDR queue unless lead score >=30 then push to enterprise AE. I can set the flow but need final UTMs and confirmation on the registration form fields.

Sam: UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=product-launch-mar2026, utm_content=heroA|heroB. Recommend inline registration above the fold (no gating) — our conversion is higher that way. Also we should A/B test CTA text.

Jess: CTA text options I'll include in the Figma: 1) "Save my spot" (preferred) 2) "Register" 3) "Get early access".

Elaine: Good. @Mike can you also provide a 2-line AE outreach blurb plus one metric they can lead with? Sales wants something they can paste into outreach cadences.

Mike: Yep — I'll draft a 2-line template + 1 bullet with the impact stat (once Oliver confirms numbers). Will share in the doc.

Oliver: Confirmed in the benchmark sheet: p95=118ms (redwood-4x, 2k seq) and cost delta = 28% lower vs our internal baseline config. I'll paste the methodology link: https://internal.example.com/benchmarks/redwood-4x. Use wording: "based on internal testing; p95 latency ~118ms and up to 28% lower inference cost."

Nora: LGTM with that wording but include the footnote: "Results depend on workload and configuration; see methodology." No customer logos.

Jess: Pushed hero mocks to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ExampleHero — variant A is a compact chart, variant B is a live UI screenshot. I cropped the screenshot for privacy.

Elaine: I'm locking copy/design handoff at 5pm. If no objections I'll schedule: publish 2026-03-26 12:00 PT and webinar 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Anyone object to dates?

Mike: SGTM. I'll create HubSpot event, set UTMs, and prep the SDR doc.

Sam: SGTM. I'll queue paid social and set up the A/B test for hero content (start day of publish).

Oliver: All bench numbers attached in the sheet above. No changes from my side.

Nora: Approved from Legal with the "based on internal testing" footnote; no customer names or logos.

Elaine: Awesome — thanks all. I'll update the doc with final UTMs and AE blurb, set the schedule, and ping again once the publish is scheduled. :rocket:
